import json
listing = currentProgram.getListing()
mem = currentProgram.getMemory()
start = currentProgram.getAddressFactory().getAddress("140af0280")
end = currentProgram.getAddressFactory().getAddress("140af03c0")
out = []
addr = start
while addr.compareTo(end) < 0:
    inst = listing.getInstructionAt(addr)
    if inst is not None:
        out.append("%s  %s" % (inst.getAddress(), inst))
        addr = inst.getMinAddress().add(inst.getLength())
        continue
    b = mem.getByte(addr)
    out.append("%s  db %02x" % (addr, b & 0xff))
    addr = addr.add(1)
print(json.dumps(out))
